changes.value: Anodized aluminium wall in cool steel blue-grey with fine circular brush grain, meeting a continuous honed aluminium ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame; the wall darkens gently toward the left third and carries one broad calm sheen band low on the right half; the honed ground shows a faint soft vertical reflection and slight tonal deepening near the centre-right; cool diffuse twilight illumination, matte metal grain, no hard shadows, no objects
